description: Buy one LeadFuzion lead package (one item_id) at its listed price. Call get_package_quote first: it is free and shows the price. Without payment this returns the price and how to pay (x402 USDC on Base, MPP card, or MPP Tempo), and nothing is charged. If your client cannot pay inside MCP, pay at the HTTPS URL given and pass the order_token back here.

accept_terms.description: Must be true: you accept the terms at terms_url.

buyer.description: Who is buying: person or company name plus a contact. Recorded with the order.

order_token.description: Proof of a purchase already paid at the HTTPS endpoint or in an earlier call. Redelivers that order; no charge, no attestation needed. Valid 7 days.

purpose.description: What the leads will be used for. Recorded with the order.

name: buy_package
title: Buy a lead package
